what: The United Arab Emirates left OPEC and OPEC+ on 1 May 2026. It was still listed as a member; it is now shown as having left in 2026, and OPEC and OPEC+ totals, shares and outlines leave it out.

South Africa joined BRICS in 2011, after an invitation in December 2010; it was shown as joining in 2010. Saudi Arabia, which BRICS lists as a member, is now shown as a member from 2024 with the note that Saudi Arabia has not confirmed it; it was shown as invited. BRICS totals, shares and outlines now include it.
